# Secrets Checklist: WARP Registration & Endpoint Scan

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of secret handling across identity storage, license keys, and redaction of new artifacts
**Created**: 2026-09-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK050 Are storage requirements defined for every new secret (device key, access token, MASQUE key, license key in memory)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK051 Are in-memory lifetime requirements defined for the per-operation license key (when is it zeroized)? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK052 Are file-permission requirements defined for identity records on all supported platforms? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK053 Are atomic-write requirements defined for all identity mutations (register, refresh, rotate, discard)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §US-003]
- [ ] CHK054 Are key-generation requirements defined for locally created device keys? [Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK055 Is "readable only by the user" quantified per platform (POSIX mode, Windows ACL equivalent)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK056 Is "discarded" for replaced identities defined (deleted from disk, zeroized, or dereferenced)? [Clarity, Spec §US-003]
- [ ] CHK057 Is the flag-use stderr warning text specified (exact trigger, exact channel)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK058 Is the license key's never-persisted rule consistent with retry-inside-one-operation (memory reuse vs re-prompt)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK059 Are redaction requirements for RegistrationReport consistent with the existing central-redaction rules (no new ad-hoc paths)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK060 Is refusal-cause redaction consistent — can a provider refusal embed identity material that must be scrubbed? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK061 Can SC-005 (zero secrets in outputs, hygiene suite extended) be objectively measured, including the artifact list? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK062 Are the registration artifacts enumerated for hygiene coverage (store files, reports, error output, cache)? [Completeness, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK063 Are requirements defined for double-registration races discarding the loser's secrets, not just the record? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK064 Are requirements defined for corrupt-store recovery discarding unparseable secret material safely? [Coverage, Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK065 Are requirements defined for license key handling when the operation fails midway (key lifetime on error paths)? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK066 Are requirements defined for GOOL pair isolation (outer renewal never exposes inner secrets and vice versa)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK067 Are transport-security requirements specified for the registration channel itself (encryption, authentication of the provider)? [Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK068 Is the assumption that existing central redaction covers all new flows validated (new field inventory vs redactor keys)? [Assumption, Spec §FR-012]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK069 Does "used for the operation" conflict with any retry that outlives the initial call (re-prompt vs retain)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK070 Is "prompt used when a TTY is present" behavior specified when neither TTY, flag, nor file is available? [Gap]

## Re-sweep (post-analyze, 2026-09-16)

- [ ] CHK107 Are transient-buffer requirements specified for secrets that must cross process/API boundaries (request bodies, auth headers) — allowed to exist transiently, never to persist? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK108 Are secret-placement requirements specified (which secrets live in the keyring vs file fallback, and what isolates one profile's secrets from another's)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK109 Are registration-report field requirements specified as an allowlist (which fields may exist) so future secret classes cannot leak by addition? [Completeness, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK110 Are license-upgrade failure requirements specified (is a refused key fatal or best-effort, and exactly what is the user told)? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK111 Are MASQUE key-lifecycle requirements specified distinctly from WARP device-key requirements (generation, storage, and destruction of the rotated-out key)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
